task: C8235-01 / R-01: U2900 short-clip and U2901 reset-contact preflight
status: Pi startup fails with clip seated on U2900; disconnected Pi/adapter starts with 1.802 V output; detached clip/cable control requested.

target.other_chip_grabber: Owner attached micrograbber to physicalpin3/RESET#; free end confirmed loose, no resistor/ground connected.

datasheet.identity: Micron MT25QU256ABA Rev.L02/2024, page12 Figure6/packageSF and page14 Table1
datasheet.facts: DedicatedRESET# is physicalpin3; a lowRESET resets the part and releases its data outputs. These device facts do not establish independent reset routing on this board.

requested_small_batch.status: Contact and reset-toVCC readings complete. Fresh post-clip header DC value not separately reported; prior header0V and explicit all-power-disconnected confirmation retained. No power-up selected.

Validate current supply and signal levels/loading before SPI acquisition; no automatic power-up follows passive measurements.
If needed, qualify a current-limited reset trial before bounded read-only identification/data checks. Preserve stable separate full-chip reads before restore selection.
powered_programming_or_read: Owner attempted Pi-only supply of the U2900-connected fixture; Pi did not start and the target rail briefly displayed about 0.1 V. Pi starts disconnected; adapter output subsequently reported as 1.802 V. No agent GPIO/SPI/flash operation, read or write.

output_disconnected_control.requested_setup: Pi power unplugged and converter OUTPUT 8-to-4 at 0 V before removing the entire clip cable from the converter OUTPUT. Leave Pi-to-converter INPUT wiring unchanged. Router leads/grabbers free and router own power disconnected. Power only Pi/converter once with OUTPUT empty.
output_disconnected_control.initial_reply: a disconnected pi starts up fine
output_disconnected_control.clarification_requested: Was the adapter still connected to the Pi with only the clip cable removed from OUTPUT? If so, measure directly OUTPUT 8 positive to OUTPUT 4 ground; leave clip disconnected.
output_disconnected_control.setup_scope: Voltage supplied in direct response to the adapter-connected/output-empty control clarification; treated as that control result in context. Owner did not separately restate all wiring conditions.
output_disconnected_control.result: Pi startup and expected converter output reported without the router load. This supports basic Pi/converter operation in the disconnected setup; it does not qualify the clip/cable, loaded regulator capacity or board supply path.

detached_clip_control_request.purpose: Separate clip/cable effects from the router board load without repeating the failed connected trial.
sequence: Shut down Pi, unplug USB-C power and wait for converter OUTPUT 8-to-4 to read 0 V.
Remove short clip completely from U2900. Keep metal contacts separated with a clean nonconductive spacer and clear of the router; board leads and reset grabber remain loose.
Reconnect clip cable to converter OUTPUT in its existing orientation. Nothing from Pi/converter/clip is connected to the router.
Power only Pi once; report whether it starts and DC voltage directly from OUTPUT 8 (+) to OUTPUT 4 (ground). If startup fails, unplug it.
detached_clip_control_request.instruction: Do not reconnect router or move powered wiring. No reset resistor, GPIO/SPI command or flash access.
